data.headline: Comcast Slows Internet, TV Losses Amid Heavy Promotion Cycle
data.summary: The Philadelphia-based media company lost 104,000 net broadband subscribers in the period, fewer than the loss of 140,000 predicted by analysts.  The cable provider reported a net loss of 257,000 video subscribers, according to a statement on Thursday.  Comcast’s internet and cable TV businesses have been under pressure from changing consumer preferences as customers cut the cord in favor of streaming services and flock to fiber and 5G home internet plans offered by Verizon Communications Inc., T-Mobile US Inc. and AT&T Inc. The competition has forced Comcast management to respond on several fronts, including offering cheaper plans at slower speeds for low-income consumers.
